name: Crab Claws
description: Twin chitinous pincers that snap in a frontal arc.

name: Serrated Beak
description: Sharp snapping mandibles that tear prey and speed up feeding.

name: Chitin Spike
description: Impaling horn thrust whose damage scales with your actual movement speed.

name: Venomous Barb
description: Launches toxic darts toward your cursor that inflict stacking Poison DoT.

name: Crusher Pincers
description: Heavy armored claws that slam enemies, dealing bonus damage from your Plating.

name: Mantis Scythes
description: Reaping forelimbs that cleave wide arcs and grant critical velocity strikes.

name: Ankylosaur Tail Club
description: Shockwave tail slam scaling with Max HP that stuns nearby enemies.

name: Pistol Shrimp Pincer
description: Cavitation bubble blast that fires a superheated plasma shockwave across the screen.

name: Bio-Electric Organ
description: Releases radial chain-lightning pulses that stun all creatures in range.

name: Vampiric Proboscis
description: Piercing siphon strike that heals you for 30% of damage dealt.

name: Raptor Leap
description: Enhances your Spacebar dash with an explosive landing shockwave.

name: Crab Sidestep
description: Ten-legged crab locomotion that boosts dodge chance and dash recovery.

name: Cephalopod Siphon Jet
description: Fires a pressurized ink cloud behind you when dashing and grants water mastery.

name: Chonky
description: Massively increases Max HP and body Size with a slight speed trade-off.

name: Calcified Scales
description: Adds Damage Reduction points and Heat Resistance.

name: Insulating Blubber
description: Thick thermal layer granting Cold Resistance, Snow adaptation, and Max HP.

name: Arthropod Joints
description: Reduces movement penalties across Sand, Snow, and Water while boosting speed.

name: Apex Predator Instinct
description: Boosts Physical Damage and Apex Predator Score, intimidating lower-rank creatures.

name: Stalked Compound Eyes
description: Expands night vision radius, Senses, and XP gained from all food sources.

name: Regenerative Molt
description: Continuously regenerates HP and slowly restores Plating over time.

name: Pheromone Gland
description: Passively charms nearby smaller creatures to fight and forage alongside you.

name: Boss Evolution: Chimera Arms
description: Boss Fruit Mutation: Grows secondary raptorial arms that boost attack damage & cooldown speed.

name: Boss Evolution: Leviathan Carapace
description: Boss Fruit Mutation: Grants massive Plating, Damage Reduction, and spawns Plating when hurt.

name: Extremophile Adaptation
description: Thrives in hostile biomes, granting Heat/Cold immunity, Last Stand chance, and all-stat scaling.
